Career Objective:

Work in a challenging role utilizing my technical skills along with my professional experience to effectively contribute to the growth of the organization.

Professional Experience:

Company: Job title: Project Names:

Duration:

Accenture Solutions Private Limited Business Analyst Standard Chartered Bank, Nationwide Building Society and Eradah Capital February 2021 to June 2026

Roles & Responsibilities:

Working closely with the Business PO to understand the business requirements

which pertain to International Payments.

Communicating with stakeholders and other departments to provide solutions for the product requirements, to solve the existing issues in BAU and to reduce the manual work.

Experienced in handling MX message migration in core Transaction Processing

system – ISO 20022.

Experienced with Cross border SWIFT payments – Pacs.008, Pacs.009, Pacs.009COV, MT103, MT202, MT202COV in India Telegraphic Transfer (TT). • Responsible for creating user stories in Jira and Azure DevOps tools and presenting to the squad.

Closely working with scrum by following the Agile methodology, attending daily scrum call to discuss the updates towards the requirement activity and resolve if any issues.

Having knowledge in API interfaces between core processing system and other

associated applications.

Experienced at analyzing the current business model for performing Gap analysis

and generating ‘As – Is’ and ‘To – Be’ process flows.

Having knowledge on Payments, Treasury and Reconciliation tool’s UAT testing. • Having knowledge on Payments Screening application and the Fircosoft format.

Company: Job title: Process Name: Duration:

BNP Paribas Global Securities Operations Private Limited Assistant Manager Middle Office Derivatives Operation (Trade Booking) April 2020 to October 2020

Roles & Responsibilities:

Monitoring the Derivatives Trade Booking team daily to ensure the trade instructions received from the client are booked on the system in a timely manner without any errors.

Making sure the checklist activities are done within the deadline. • Taking complete ownership of the team, provide road maps to the team towards driving the goals of the organization.

Decision making on the work allocation and cross training plan for the team. • Review quality errors and provide feedback to the team to maintain accuracy in the process.

Maintaining a good rapport with onshore and internal department to run the

process smoothly.

Company: Job title: Process Name: Duration:

BNY Mellon International Operations (India) Private Limited Senior Analyst Transfer Agency November 2016 to April 2020

Roles & Responsibilities:

Reconciliation of Bank accounts (Client money, Operating and Distribution account) and control accounts using TLM as a reconciliation tool to maintain accurate records for each client.

Reviewing the activities performed by the Operations executive to ensure the outstanding breaks on the reconciliation are valid and to investigate in clearing the breaks.

Handling the queries from onshore and internal department in a timely manner. • Preparing the MIS report to submit to onshore monthly. • Providing process improvement ideas (auto match rules and automation of reports) to reduce the manual work on the process.

Company: Job title: Process Name: Duration:

State Street HCL Services Specialist Alternative Investment Services (Hedge Funds) September 2014 to September 2016

Roles & Responsibilities:





• •



Reconciliation of daily cash and position between multiple prime brokers and maintaining accounting records for multiple currencies. Gathering of various broker reports from sources like broker websites and client mails. Booking all accruals, interest, charges and payments on a daily/monthly basis. Protection of Customers Confidential data and preventing it from outsiders. To follow up with the operations team for any trade-related breaks and clear them from Reconciliation tool. Successfully worked on reduction of manual work in the account setup of the fund.

Worked closely with team members to understand their knowledge and provide training to improve their skill set.

Company: Job title: Process Name: Duration:

RBS Business Services Private Limited Process Associate International Payments November 2011 to May 2014

Operational Roles and Responsibilities:

•











Performing the prechecks for the instructions received through various modes. Processing and verifying the Domestic and International transfers including all incoming, outgoing, and internal payments, also handling client issues raised by the internal team. Creating and verifying the telex messages (MT192, MT195, MT196 and MT199). Processing and verifying Amendments, Cancellations, Return of funds and MT 191 claims. Input the required payment details into Non STP payments which fall in the Repair queue due to invalid formatting and insufficient details. Communicating with banks through swift messages such as MT199, MT999 and email. Contacting respective banks through SWIFT and making appropriate escalation for a speedy resolution.

Professional Experience:
Company: Job title: Project Names:
Duration:
Accenture Solutions Private Limited Business Analyst Standard Chartered Bank, Nationwide Building Society and Eradah Capital February 2021 to June 2026
Roles & Responsibilities:
Working closely with the Business PO to understand the business requirements
which pertain to International Payments.
Communicating with stakeholders and other departments to provide solutions for the product requirements, to solve the existing issues in BAU and to reduce the manual work.
Experienced in handling MX message migration in core Transaction Processing
system – ISO 20022.
Experienced with Cross border SWIFT payments – Pacs.008, Pacs.009, Pacs.009COV, MT103, MT202, MT202COV in India Telegraphic Transfer (TT). • Responsible for creating user stories in Jira and Azure DevOps tools and presenting to the squad.
Closely working with scrum by following the Agile methodology, attending daily scrum call to discuss the updates towards the requirement activity and resolve if any issues.
Having knowledge in API interfaces between core processing system and other
associated applications.
Experienced at analyzing the current business model for performing Gap analysis
and generating ‘As – Is’ and ‘To – Be’ process flows.
Having knowledge on Payments, Treasury and Reconciliation tool’s UAT testing. • Having knowledge on Payments Screening application and the Fircosoft format.
Company: Job title: Process Name: Duration:
BNP Paribas Global Securities Operations Private Limited Assistant Manager Middle Office Derivatives Operation (Trade Booking) April 2020 to October 2020
Roles & Responsibilities:
Monitoring the Derivatives Trade Booking team daily to ensure the trade instructions received from the client are booked on the system in a timely manner without any errors.
Making sure the checklist activities are done within the deadline. • Taking complete ownership of the team, provide road maps to the team towards driving the goals of the organization.
Decision making on the work allocation and cross training plan for the team. • Review quality errors and provide feedback to the team to maintain accuracy in the process.
Maintaining a good rapport with onshore and internal department to run the
process smoothly.
Company: Job title: Process Name: Duration:
BNY Mellon International Operations (India) Private Limited Senior Analyst Transfer Agency November 2016 to April 2020
Roles & Responsibilities:
Reconciliation of Bank accounts (Client money, Operating and Distribution account) and control accounts using TLM as a reconciliation tool to maintain accurate records for each client.
Reviewing the activities performed by the Operations executive to ensure the outstanding breaks on the reconciliation are valid and to investigate in clearing the breaks.
Handling the queries from onshore and internal department in a timely manner. • Preparing the MIS report to submit to onshore monthly. • Providing process improvement ideas (auto match rules and automation of reports) to reduce the manual work on the process.
Company: Job title: Process Name: Duration:
State Street HCL Services Specialist Alternative Investment Services (Hedge Funds) September 2014 to September 2016
Roles & Responsibilities:


• •

Reconciliation of daily cash and position between multiple prime brokers and maintaining accounting records for multiple currencies. Gathering of various broker reports from sources like broker websites and client mails. Booking all accruals, interest, charges and payments on a daily/monthly basis. Protection of Customers Confidential data and preventing it from outsiders. To follow up with the operations team for any trade-related breaks and clear them from Reconciliation tool. Successfully worked on reduction of manual work in the account setup of the fund.
Worked closely with team members to understand their knowledge and provide training to improve their skill set.
Company: Job title: Process Name: Duration:
RBS Business Services Private Limited Process Associate International Payments November 2011 to May 2014
Operational Roles and Responsibilities:
•





Performing the prechecks for the instructions received through various modes. Processing and verifying the Domestic and International transfers including all incoming, outgoing, and internal payments, also handling client issues raised by the internal team. Creating and verifying the telex messages (MT192, MT195, MT196 and MT199). Processing and verifying Amendments, Cancellations, Return of funds and MT 191 claims. Input the required payment details into Non STP payments which fall in the Repair queue due to invalid formatting and insufficient details. Communicating with banks through swift messages such as MT199, MT999 and email. Contacting respective banks through SWIFT and making appropriate escalation for a speedy resolution.
